title: GodzillaDN.com — Premium Domain Marketplace
css_framework: Tailwind CSS v4 + custom CSS variables

typography.monospace_font: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, SF Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

background_layers: Dot pattern (mint dots 22px grid, masked to 60%)
hero_section.eyebrow: monospace 11px, 'Godzilla DN . Apex domain marketplace', green dot with glow
hero_section.featured_domain_carousel: 8 domains, dot pagination (18px active mint dot, 6px inactive dark green)
hero_section.headline: 'Premium domains, hunted and held.' medium weight #E8F0EC
hero_section.search_bar: rounded-full, #0A1113 bg, mint border, coral submit button, Lucide search icon
hero_section.bottom_padding: pb-52 sm:pb-60 (space for card grid overlapping)

claimed_ticker.type: horizontal marquee, 46s linear infinite, pauses on hover
claimed_ticker.label: 'Claimed' in #FF5A36 coral, monospace, absolute positioned with gradient fade

domain_cards.card_style: flat with grid-line borders (rgba(70,229,198,0.14)), no rounded corners
domain_cards.tld_badge: 11px monospace uppercase, TLD in #4C6259, Available in #46E5C6
domain_cards.hover_reveal: 'Claim it' slides in from left (#FF5A36), crosshair icon appears top-right
domain_cards.category_colors: subtle amber/emerald/violet tints for different categories

how_it_works.section_label: monospace 11px uppercase, triangular zigzag SVG in #46E5C6

services_section.layout: stacked full-width list rows with bottom borders
services_section.hover: arrow shifts diagonally, bg color change

cta_section.decoration: triangular mountain SVG in #46E5C6 with opacity variation
cta_section.heading: 'Claim your name.' 4xl-6xl font-black with mint text-shadow glow
cta_section.button: rounded-full h-12 px-7 #FF5A36 bg #1A0A06 text, brightness-110 hover

footer.top_decoration: dual-layer triangular mountain SVG (#05080A base + #46E5C6 glow at 25%)
footer.trust_section: Escrow.com trust badges, GoDaddy, Spaceship logos

navigation.links: Marketplace, Browse(search icon), Claw(New badge), Agents(New badge), Services, Claimed, $99 domains(mint serif), How it works, FAQ, Free tools(external arrow)
navigation.new_badge: 9px monospace uppercase mint pill with 10% bg and 20% border

animations.ticker: 46s linear infinite translateX marquee, pauses on hover

design_language.aesthetic: Dark-mode premium tech-forward domain marketplace. Minimalist with strategic accent color use.
key_principles: Extreme dark theme #05080A with blue-green undertone
Single dominant accent #46E5C6 (mint) for brand identity and glow effects
Single action accent #FF5A36 (coral) for CTAs and urgency
Monospace typography for all metadata creating data-terminal aesthetic
Mint glow/text-shadow on hero headings for ethereal premium feel
Grid-line borders on domain cards (no rounded corners)
Hover-reveal interactions ('Claim it' slides in, crosshair appears)
Triangular mountain/zigzag SVGs as brand motif dividers
Noise texture overlay at 7% for grain/depth
Pill/rounded-full shapes for buttons and badges only
Inline styles heavily used (likely for dynamic theming)
design_language.mood: Dark, authoritative, premium, tech-savvy, minimal but expressive
